x.label: How much your outfit decides it

y.label: How much everything else decides it

clubs.name: Berghain / Panorama Bar
clubs.area: Friedrichshain, Am Wriezener Bahnhof, S Ostbahnhof
clubs.when: Panorama Bar from around midnight on Friday, Klubnacht from around midnight on Saturday until Monday morning
clubs.reads: Whether you look like someone who came for the room and not for the story about the room. Groups get split, phones get read, loud English gets read, drunk gets read.
clubs.rule: Both phone lenses are covered with a sticker at the door and photography inside is not allowed.
clubs.line: The hardest door in the city, and the one where an outfit helps you least. People overdress for it constantly.
clubs.queue: One to three hours at peak. Sunday afternoon is the quiet arrival.

clubs.name: Tresor
clubs.area: Mitte, Kraftwerk on Kopenicker Strasse, U Heinrich-Heine-Strasse
clubs.when: Friday and Saturday nights from around midnight
clubs.reads: Sobriety, group size and whether you are calm in the queue. There is no published dress code at all.
clubs.rule: Tresor's own guest information says strictly no filming or photos inside, and guests found doing it are removed. The cloakroom is self-service, so bring a charged phone with NFC switched on.
clubs.line: Easier than Berghain and still not a guarantee. Dark and plain is not a rule, it is just what people wear.
clubs.queue: Twenty minutes to an hour on a normal Saturday.

clubs.name: Sisyphos
clubs.area: Lichtenberg, Rummelsburg, S Rummelsburg or S Ostkreuz then a bus
clubs.when: Friday night straight through to Monday
clubs.reads: Whether you arrive as a person or as a tour group. It is a former dog biscuit factory turned festival site and the door protects that feeling.
clubs.rule: Phone cameras are stickered at the door.
clubs.line: The queue is the real filter here. In summer it can run for hours before anyone even looks at you.
clubs.queue: Up to several hours on a warm weekend.

clubs.name: ://about blank
clubs.when: Friday night and Saturday night, often running into Monday
clubs.reads: Whether you understand it is a political collective with a garden attached, not a nightlife product. Awareness culture is loud and taken seriously.
clubs.rule: Camera stickers at the door and a visible awareness team inside.
clubs.line: One of the friendlier doors if you are quiet and alone or in a pair, one of the harder ones for a stag party.
clubs.queue: Half an hour to two hours.

clubs.name: RSO.Berlin
clubs.area: Niederschoeneweide, Schnellerstrasse, on the old Baerenquell brewery site
clubs.season: all year, open air in summer
clubs.when: Friday and Saturday nights, often with a Sunday daytime floor
clubs.reads: Effort. Not money, effort. This is the club that grew out of Griessmuehle after it lost its site, and the door protects that inheritance.
clubs.line: The furthest out of the twelve and the one most likely to reject a group that turns up in holiday clothes at 01:00.
clubs.queue: Long at peak, short before midnight.

clubs.name: Kater
clubs.area: Friedrichshain, Holzmarktstrasse 25, S Jannowitzbruecke or S Ostbahnhof
clubs.reads: Very little beyond being sober and pleasant. This is the wooden shacks and circus tents club on the Spree.
clubs.rule: Camera stickers at the door. Tickets are usually bought at the door, roughly 20 to 25 euro.
clubs.line: It was Kater Blau until August 2025 and the name is still what everyone searches. Same site, same door, shorter name.

clubs.name: Salon zur Wilden Renate
clubs.reads: Whether you are going to treat an old flat full of rooms like a nightclub or like someone's home.
clubs.line: It announced its own closure for the end of 2025 and then secured the lease in December 2025. It is still here, which is not something Berlin says often.

clubs.name: Ritter Butzke
clubs.reads: Sobriety and group size, mostly. A relaxed individual look reads better here than an expensive one.
clubs.rule: House rules on phones vary by night.
clubs.line: A fair door with a very long queue, because it is popular and the rooms fill fast. Four floors and a summer courtyard.

clubs.name: Club der Visionaere
clubs.area: Treptow, Am Flutgraben, on the canal, U Schlesisches Tor
clubs.season: summer only, completely shut in winter
clubs.when: Afternoons onward through the weekend, weather permitting
clubs.reads: Almost nothing. It is a wooden shack and a terrace over the water.
clubs.rule: No special phone rule. It is an outdoor bar as much as a club.
clubs.line: The one on this chart with effectively no door. If you have been rejected somewhere and want the night to still be good, this is where you go.
clubs.queue: Rarely more than a few minutes.

clubs.name: Else
clubs.area: Alt-Treptow, under the Elsenbruecke, S Treptower Park
clubs.season: summer only, opened for the 2026 season on 24 April
clubs.when: Friday afternoon through to Monday morning
clubs.reads: Very little. Sand, a bar and a bridge overhead.
clubs.rule: No special phone rule most nights.
clubs.line: The daylight option next door to about blank. Different door, same corner of the city.

clubs.name: Matrix
clubs.area: Friedrichshain, Warschauer Platz, under the U-Bahn arches
clubs.when: Several nights a week, closing around 05:00
clubs.reads: Your clothes, and almost nothing else. This is the one venue here that runs a normal commercial dress code and turns people away for sportswear.
clubs.rule: No underground camera rule. Phones are used freely.
clubs.line: It is on this chart because it is the opposite of everything else on it. Chart music, big crowd, smart-casual door. Nobody is testing your taste.

clubs.name: KitKatClub
clubs.reads: The outfit, completely and openly. This is the only door on the chart with a published, enforced dress code, and street clothes are refused.
clubs.rule: Strict no photography. Changing rooms on site.
clubs.line: The far right edge of the chart exists because of this club. Everywhere else, dressing up is a guess. Here it is the entry condition.
clubs.queue: Moderate, and the check is at the door not in the queue.
